BFA.note: Nothing on rules or authority for AI harms.

facts.fact: Digital Magazine Burkina, citing Lefaso.net, says the Burkinabe government already uses CITADEL's French-Moore speech translation system to broadcast information in Moore on the Burkina-en-marche.gov.bf platform.

BFA.note: Platform content on health and education is general administration, not a sector system.

facts.fact: Digital Magazine Burkina reports CITADEL built a French-Moore speech translation system on a 150-hour audio corpus (4.24% error rate) that is already operational, and fine-tuned text translation models on 83,000 validated French-Moore sentence pairs.
